identity.name: Heritage Collection Hi-Beat
identity.one_liner: A 62GS-shaped Hi-Beat automatic with a green dial marking rikka, the start of summer in Japan's 24-season calendar, discontinued in 2025 and replaced by the SBGH351.

narrative.story: The SBGH271 carries the 62GS case — the sharp-lined, bezel-free shape introduced on the original 1967 62GS — into the Heritage Collection's Sekki line, which ties dial designs to Japan's 24 traditional micro-seasons. Its nickname Rikka names the early-summer season, reflected in a green dial. Grand Seiko launched it in 2019, initially as part of a US-exclusive four-watch Seasons release, and ran caliber 9S85, a Hi-Beat 36000 automatic movement. Grand Seiko discontinued it in February 2025 and replaced it with the SBGH351.
narrative.collector_notes: Now discontinued; the successor SBGH351 uses the same 62GS case and 9S85 caliber with revised dial finishing, so buyers comparing the two should check dial texture and case-back engraving to confirm which reference a listing is describing.
